description: Creates an exercise group (circuit or sets). Use when the user wants to group exercises for circuits or micro-workouts. Requires at least 2 exercise IDs from list_team_exercises.

exercise_ids.description: Exercise IDs in order, at least 2, from list_team_exercises.

group_type.description: "circuit" = one exercise after another, then repeat; "sets" = all rounds of one exercise before the next.

rest_seconds.description: Rest between rounds in seconds, e.g. 30.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

name: create_exercise_group
title: Create exercise group
